what: Dental Lifeline Network matches eligible adults with volunteer dentists and laboratories for comprehensive care.
Colorado has separate Denver-metro and rest-of-state coordinators; treatment is non-emergency and noncosmetic.
Applicants may qualify through age, disability, medical necessity or recurrent infection when unable to afford care.
strengths: A concrete volunteer treatment mechanism operates in Denver.
Accepted national health and signed-resource evidence is reused transparently.
Paid care, free alternatives and genuinely additional care are separate cohorts.
reservations: Current unique Denver completions and restricted capacity are unknown.
National general donations do not guarantee Denver allocation.
The currently linked state report is2021–22, not current annual treatment.

model.costScope: Exact reused national donor10kframework; partial judged Denver attribution, not annual operating-cost ratio or local funding offer.
model.geographicAttribution: Judged .04national incremental cohort/resource share inside ten-county DenverCBSA; .01/.08/0/1sensitivities; no residence/capacity measurement.
model.formula: N=min(G*b/c,capacity), C=N*r; buyers=C*p, free=C*(1-p)*(1-s), A=C*(1-p)*s. Clinical=g*[A*(u*exp(-ln(1+d)*L)*integral_0^T exp(-(ln(1+d)+m+loss+catchup)*t)dt-h*exp(-ln(1+d)*L))-N*ha]. Resources sum signed per-household logarithmic receipt flows. Positive wages use independence; negative wages and direct cash burdens are charged fully. Combined=clinical+resources; donor price=10*G/combined only if positive and known. Denver g=.04 applied once to health and signed resources.
model.counterfactual: No-new-gift includes committed public/private support, existing volunteer slots, insurance exhaustion, medically linked Medicare, other free providers and delayed private care. Otherwise purchasers and equivalent same-time free care have no incremental clinical benefit or matched treatment harm. Additional application burdens remain.
model.attribution: Funding response, completion, otherwise purchasing, same-time alternatives and later catchup are separate judged pathways. Common-alive earnings are not survival-created pay. One candidate-equivalent is one representative household; no hidden household-size or patient-repeat multiplier. Denver share is new judgment, not re-estimated national efficacy.
model.uncertainty: Local completed cohort, restricted capacity, matched state budget and residence unknown. Underlying national clinical/resource judgments reused, not empirical local effects.
